limitations: One-dimensional homogeneous liquid screening; no three-dimensional CFD or original-paper numerical replication
Synthetic assay; frozen density/heat capacity; assumed axial dispersion and heat-transfer coefficients
Newtonian hydraulic estimate excludes emulsions, yield stress and transient momentum
WAT, cold-oil exposure, deposition and connected gel length are distinct; restart yield stresses are assumed
Fixed two-pipe-volume observation window; ML interpolation only within the synthetic case basis
ML accuracy measures approximation of the discrete model, not agreement with field or CFD observations
